newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end lower in light trade.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures finished a volatile afternoon lower but off the lowest levels of the session after a late rally pared losses.
Despite the sharp recovery, which occurred on light volume, some participants remained wary of the near-term outlook.
"The bounce was on nothing," said one S&P 500 trader on the floor of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
Pressure emerged near midday after an unsteady morning session in which prices hovered in narrow ranges. Sentiment had been somewhat negative after the weak close on Friday, some traders said.
Selling picked up after the close of the bond futures market, and traders noted a few arbitrage sell programs which fueled losses in the cash market.
Traders said arb sell program were triggered when the premium of the March S&P 500 contract narrowed below about 5.10 points.
However, short-covering surfaced which quickly pared losses and pushed the nearby S&P contract up near the bottom of the morning range.

U.S. economic data this morning, including slightly lower than expected consumer spending and a weaker than anticipated consumer sentiment index from the University of Michigan, had little impact on prices, traders said.
Some expect pressure to again emerge during Tuesday's holiday-shortened session.
"The market is on shaky ground right now," said Kevin O'Brien, stock index futures analyst at Prudential Securities. "There's been no holiday buying, which we normally see about this time."
Stock index futures trading ends at 1215 CST on Tuesday and is closed all day Wednesday for the Christmas holiday.
Nikkei 225 stock index futures ended quietly lower after the holiday in Japan overnight, with only about 300 contracts trading all session.

At settlement, March S&P 500s were off 3.15 points at 754.10, Russell 2000s eased 0.90 point to 359.10, Value Line futures were off 3.40 point to 683.00, Nikkei 225 index futures eased 40.0 to 19,570.0 and Midcap 400s eased 0.55 point to 254.50.
